title: Ding Talaingat ning Hardin
intro: King metung a malabung a mula, ing metung a komunidad ginawa yang solemning panata. Pero ing karelang determinasyun mesubukan ya inyang ing banal a kaburian mekialam ya, at gewa na ing karelang kayapan king metung a gabun a alang tanaman.
clues: Bendisyunan na kami ning dakal a mula, oneng meging mayabang kami.
Megplanu kaming mamupul alang pamidake kareng pakakalulu.
Miglakbe kaming maranun, tiwala keng kekaming planu.
Pero inyang miras kami, ikit mi na mesira ya ing kekaming hardin kilub ning bengi.
abalu mi ing kekaming kamalian at megumpisa kaming misisi king metung at metung.
Megsisi kami keng tauli, pero ing aral mebalu ya masyadung malambat.

metung a hukbu da reng ayup a lulusub
Maragul a angin a mekapag-ugat kareng dutung

outcome.label: Kelabasan

outcome.answer: Megsisi la pero mewala ing garden da

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
